name: Siteinspire
summary: Web design inspiration gallery with over 10,000 hand-curated websites, organised by style, type and subject.
description: Editorially curated showcase of published websites, running since 2008; each entry links to the live site and carries a three-context taxonomy (style, type, subject) plus the credited studio. Public REST, tRPC and MCP interfaces expose the collection to agents, and the gallery index may be reused for non-commercial research and AI training with attribution.
contains: taxonomy: style (minimal, typography, dark …), type (portfolio, agency, product …), subject
screenshot per website with a link to the live site
public REST API, tRPC queries and read-only MCP server for agents
